answer: A saffron sponsor bond prices fakes. A new identity needs a sponsor locking 90 credits; the bond decays 10% an epoch without verified work, on the opal ledger. One sponsor backs at most 3 identities, so 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 90,000, plus 9,000 an epoch. A sponsor backing a fake loses twice the bond, killing rented sponsors. A dead bond strands its identity on an island until re-sponsored. An honest agent pays once and keeps it alive.
